import cmd
import io

class simplecmd(cmd.Cmd):

    def do_print(self, args):
        print(args, file=self.stdout)

    def do_EOF(self, args):
        return True

class simplecmd2(simplecmd):

    def do_EOF(self, args):
        print('*** Unknown syntax: EOF', file=self.stdout)
        return True

def _t():

    class _SelfNS:
        pass
    self = _SelfNS()
    self.simplecmd = simplecmd
    _SelfNS.simplecmd = simplecmd
    self.simplecmd2 = simplecmd2
    _SelfNS.simplecmd2 = simplecmd2
    input = io.StringIO('print test\nprint test2')
    output = io.StringIO()
    cmd = self.simplecmd2(stdin=input, stdout=output)
    cmd.use_rawinput = False
    cmd.cmdloop()
    assert output.getvalue() == '(Cmd) test\n(Cmd) test2\n(Cmd) *** Unknown syntax: EOF\n', ('assertMultiLineEqual', output.getvalue(), '(Cmd) test\n(Cmd) test2\n(Cmd) *** Unknown syntax: EOF\n')
    input = io.StringIO('print \n\n')
    output = io.StringIO()
    cmd.stdin = input
    cmd.stdout = output
    cmd.cmdloop()
    assert output.getvalue() == '(Cmd) \n(Cmd) \n(Cmd) *** Unknown syntax: EOF\n', ('assertMultiLineEqual', output.getvalue(), '(Cmd) \n(Cmd) \n(Cmd) *** Unknown syntax: EOF\n')
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')
